purpose: UI concepts for user choice before interface changes

proposalA.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity, technically plausible Windows WPF UI / Fluent desktop application concept, landscape 16:9 composition designed as a 1920x1080 screen. The provided image is a STYLE AND EXISTING APP CHROME reference for CubeControl, not a requirement to keep its cluttered Backing Tracks layout. Design proposal A, for a guitarist practicing and recording takes. This is a clear flat product screenshot, not a photo, not perspective, no device frame, no illustrative background, no marketing copy. Crisp typography, correct Portuguese labels, realistic native Windows controls, Segoe UI, 4px corner radii, charcoal surfaces #202020/#2B2B2B/#303030, subtle #404040 borders, warm salmon accent #FF9595 from the reference, blue backing waveforms and teal guitar waveforms. Small icons, no neon/glow/gradients, no new logo. Preserve the compact Windows title bar CubeControl and the existing five horizontal app navigation tabs: Pedaleira, IRs, Backing tracks (selected), Criador de amps, Dispositivo e ajuda. Make this app chrome more compact than the reference. USB pedal status remains a secondary small indication at top right, never the main action on this audio page.
Layout A: FULL-WIDTH HORIZONTAL RECORDING PREPARATION, no fixed left inspector. Under app navigation, a compact project strip with project 'Blues em Am', status 'Alterações não salvas', actions Novo, Abrir, Salvar, and two unobtrusive panel toggles Biblioteca and Mixer, both closed. Next, full-width main transport row with clearly labeled Gravar (salmon button with record dot), Reproduzir (play icon), Parar (square icon), large readable position '00:24.000 / 03:00', status 'Pronto para gravar', Loop A/B checkbox, BPM 90, 4/4, Velocidade 100%, Tom 0 st, Metrônomo toggle. Next, dedicated horizontal preparation row, on same surface: 'Gravar em: Guitarra', input 'Interface USB', channels 'Mono 1', thin horizontal green 'Nível de entrada' meter, checkbox 'Armar gravação' checked, 'Ouvir entrada' unchecked, 'Pré-contagem 1 compasso', output 'Fones — Interface USB'. All fields legible and separated.
Below a visibly distinct but compact editing toolbar: Importar áudio, Dividir, Desfazer, Refazer, Snap checked, division 1/4, Fade in 0,05 s, Fade out 0,10 s, Crossfade disabled, Exportar. Below, the large central arrangement with four stacked track rows, visible headers and shared musical ruler (bars), A at 9 and B at 17 selected as muted salmon strip above ruler, vertical playhead at 00:24. Four track names exactly 'Acompanhamento', 'Guitarra', 'Guitarra dobra', 'Ideias'. Track headers have colored strip, text name, compact S M R I buttons, small volume and pan. Guitarra row is selected and armed (R salmon). Waveforms are realistic variable audio shapes; main backing spans 3min, selected guitar clip about 00:24-01:04, guitar double a shorter later clip, Ideias empty with 'Arraste áudio aqui'. Timeline should use most of the available width and height, no huge blank empty black regions. Show selected guitar clip labeled 'Solo — tomada 03'. Below timeline, a slim always-visible selected-clip review strip: 'Clipe: Solo', dropdown 'Tomada 03 — ativa', buttons 'Ouvir tomada', 'Renomear', 'Anterior', 'Próxima', duration '00:40'. Bottom status 'Recuperação automática ativa' and 'Mixer recolhido', no giant mixer or open library. Some controlled breathing room, not excessively dense.
All major controls from the brief must be represented and balanced; no invented EQ, effects, plugins, meters unrelated to inputs. Prefer real legible Portuguese text over decorative microtext. Label the proposal subtly in the page heading 'Backing tracks · Proposta A'. Same content and idle ready-to-record state will be used for a second layout comparison. Return only the finished app concept image.

proposalB.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity, technically plausible Windows WPF UI / Fluent desktop app concept, landscape 16:9, designed at 1920x1080. This is PROPOSAL B in a comparison. Reference image 1 is the existing CubeControl app identity; reference image 2 is the completed Proposal A whose exact design language, chrome, content and ready-to-record state should match. Create an alternative layout, NOT a collage, flat full app screenshot, no perspective or device frame. Native-looking Segoe UI, charcoal surfaces #202020/#2B2B2B/#303030, subtle borders, 4px corner radii, warm salmon #FF9595 accent, blue backing and teal guitar waveforms. No neon, no new branding, no unnecessary effects.
Preserve top compact title bar CubeControl and five horizontal tabs Pedaleira, IRs, Backing tracks (selected), Criador de amps, Dispositivo e ajuda. Compact secondary USB status top right as in reference. Page heading 'Backing tracks · Proposta B'. Project strip same as A: 'Blues em Am', 'Alterações não salvas', Novo, Abrir, Salvar, Biblioteca and Mixer (both closed). Full-width transport row: Gravar (salmon with dot), Reproduzir, Parar, position '00:24.000 / 03:00', status 'Pronto para gravar', Loop A/B, BPM 90, 4/4, Velocidade 100%, Tom 0 st, Metrônomo.
THE DIFFERENCE: RECORDING PREPARATION IS IN A FIXED LEFT INSPECTOR, not a horizontal row. Under transport, split workspace: left inspector 280px designed width; right large timeline area fills rest. Left inspector title 'Preparar guitarra', selected track 'Guitarra', input dropdown Interface USB, channels Mono 1, clearly labelled horizontal green Nível de entrada meter, armed checked Armar gravação, unchecked Ouvir entrada, Pré-contagem dropdown 1 compasso, output Fones — Interface USB. Give this inspector generous readable labels; it should be helpful for preparing a guitar recording, not a decorative sound console. Below recording settings within same inspector show selected clip summary 'Solo', dropdown 'Tomada 03 — ativa', buttons 'Ouvir tomada', 'Renomear', smaller Anterior and Próxima, duration 00:40. This replaces the bottom full-width take strip of A, with same functionality. Bottom of inspector quiet tip 'Ouvir entrada inicia desligado'.
Above timeline at right, a compact horizontal editing toolbar with all A tools: Importar áudio, Dividir, Desfazer, Refazer, Snap checked, division 1/4, Fade in 0,05 s, Fade out 0,10 s, Crossfade disabled, Exportar. It may wrap cleanly into TWO aligned short rows to fit but no overlap. Main timeline uses available right area and height, four track rows with visible headers and musical ruler: A at bar9 B at17, playhead, track headers 'Acompanhamento', 'Guitarra' selected with R armed, 'Guitarra dobra', 'Ideias'. Track headers compact S M R I, volume slider, pan knob. Same content as A: blue backing spanning 3min, selected teal guitar clip 'Solo — tomada 03' around 00:24-01:04, shorter later double clip, empty Ideias with Arraste áudio aqui. Fill the remaining height naturally with track rows and small neutral unused timeline area, avoid a huge blank region. No open library and no expanded mixer. Bottom status strip Recuperação automática ativa, Mixer recolhido. Emphasize clarity of guitar setup and take selection, at cost of some timeline width. All Portuguese wording crisp and legible, no fake plugin/effect controls. Return only the finished app concept image.
